scope: Illustrative Carnuntum school c.AD200; separate comparative objects and kit

training_lamp.not: 74.51.1845 is a different lamp and must not illustrate post practice.
training_lamp.status_2026_10_10: Not used in the script: the object page could not be re-read on 2026-10-10 (the API confirms date, origin and public domain but not the scene). Add the image at production only if the museum page confirms a fighter at a post.

source_controls.site_plan: Antiquity2014 figure12,pp183–186 controls compound orientation. Elevations are illustrative. Retain wording interpreted school; avoid exact room occupancy.
source_controls.date: Around AD200 is narrative setting, not a construction-date or individual-day claim.

post_training_text.use: Source card S035 and the courtyard medium S036; wicker shield and wooden sword of double weight; 'of the greatest use … also to gladiators'.

colchester_vase.use: Source card S083: pot outline with the names Memnon (secutor) and Valentinus (retiarius) as captions; no copied photograph.

character_continuity.trainee: One adult unnamed composite: short dark hair, ochre waist wrap, cloth belt, bare lower legs. For ordinary room scenes use same simple wrap or plain tunic; no celebrity gladiator identification.
character_continuity.instructor: Older adult in muted short tunic; no automatically invented military rank.
character_continuity.visitor: Approved normal outfit; observes, never a paid contestant, no added sword/helmet.

kit_rules.practice: Plain short blunt wooden weapon plus modest practice shield. No hard precise claim of weight. Static staged lesson, no choreographed injurious contact.
kit_rules.secutor: Plain rounded enclosing helmet with two eye holes, large shield, short sword, weapon-arm protection. No legionary crest.
kit_rules.retiarius: No helmet; net,trident,dagger,left arm/shoulder protection. Never secutor shield or helmet.
kit_rules.object_image: No museum photograph is used in the script as released; cards are locally drawn. If the lamp image is added at production, confirm the exact object and scene first.

graphic_rules: Plans are local diagrams; solid lines for structural layout and explicit interpreted-use labels. Do not generate pseudo-geophysical heatmaps.
pilot_review: Court must look like a small school compound, not the Colosseum.
Post and trainee remain physically separate; hands, grip and shield have coherent geometry.
Bath is modest, no modern taps or fantasy palace.
Visitor never collides with local fighters or appears to wear a kit from a different type.
unperformed: Generated images, private pose production, narration and final playback do not exist yet; no approval inferred.
